criteria.statement: UsageEvent/2.0.0 represents an exact provider-reported unsettled USD amount with rate_card_ref:null, required provider_evidence_ref, reconciliation_ref:null, and existing provider_request_id may remain null.
ProviderReportedCostEvidence/1.0.0 commits to immutable source bytes separately from a domain-separated canonical record hash and distinguishes known versus explicitly unknown cost.
Evidence records distinguish per-billable-attempt association from per-key aggregates; aggregate evidence is never apportioned or treated as per-attempt.

The opt-in helper requires out-of-band owner-controlled lookup context and checks scope, reference, record hash, amount, provider/source, attempt binding and source clock; missing, mismatched, revoked or unverified lookup rejects.
Exact reported cost remains independent of usage completeness, outcome, execution finality, exposure and settlement; unknown money remains null and is never fabricated as zero.

Same-observation redelivery is pairwise classifiable despite a different transport attempt; changed economics or evidence under one observation ID conflicts; a correction uses a new observation ID and exact supersedes link.
Existing UsageEvent/1.0.0 schema/fixture bytes, checkUsageEvent, compareUsageIdentity, checkOperation dispatch and Finance surfaces retain v1 behavior.
Synthetic fixture associations are explicitly labeled and do not claim genuine provider receipts, authenticated resolver operation, Finance reconciliation or consumer adoption.

explicit_non_goals: provider, host or Finance authentication service
persistent delivery deduplication, settlement idempotency, ledger posting, reservation mutation or execution finality
provider receipt retrieval or live provider/Finance adoption
local execution, pre-ingestion, delivery or receipt identity proposal
consumer precision migration, GAP001, GAP002, CSV, draft, repair or authority service implementation
